How to use this HTML
GUIDE

How to use
this HTML

Everything this app can do, in one page.

🔐 1. Unlock

Type the password and tap Unlock Quiz. Keep Remember me ticked and you won't need to enter it again for 30 days. Use Lock app in the ⋮ menu to log out.

🏠 2. Home & practice

  • Pick a subject — English (Synonyms, Antonyms, Idioms, OWS, Spelling, Homonyms, Grammar) or General Studies (Ancient, Medieval, Modern, Geography, Polity, Economics) → then an exam set / topic.
  • Each set has tabs of 50 questions. Swipe left/right to change tab.
  • Tap an option: you instantly see right/wrong and the explanation. The yellow word is the word being asked.
  • Counters at the top show Correct / Wrong / Done. Tap ▲ or Full screen to hide the top bar for more space.

🛠️ 3. On every question

  • ☆ Save it · 🔊 hear the word · 📝 write your own note.
  • Filters: All / Unattempted / Wrong / Saved.

⏱️ 4. Mock Test

  • Choose a source: all, English, GS, one subject, 🎯 Combined (pick any subjects for an equal mix), or only Unattempted / Saved. For a section, pick a specific exam too.
  • Questions: 10, 20, 30, 50, 70, 100 or 200. Optional timer and negative marking.
  • Exam mode shows answers at the end; Practice mode shows them instantly. The result shows score, accuracy and your weak section.

♻️ 5. Revise, 🃏 Flashcards, ⭐ Saved

  • Revise Wrong: redo your mistakes — answer correctly and it leaves the list.
  • Flashcards: tap to flip, then mark Yaad hai / Nahi yaad.
  • Saved: your bookmarks grouped by section (Synonyms, Antonyms…). Open or remove any of them.

📅 6. Word of the Day & 🎯 Daily goal

A new word every day with its meaning and 🔊. Set your daily target (tap the goal card) and fill the ring. My Stats shows accuracy, streak and the last 7 days.

🎨 7. Look & feel

  • The sun/moon button cycles Light → Dark → AMOLED → Eye mode. A− / A+ change text size, B makes text bold.
  • The 🇮🇳 Hindi meaning tile turns Hindi brackets in explanations ON/OFF.

💾 8. Good to know

Your progress, notes and saved questions are stored in this browser automatically. Don't clear site data or you'll lose them.
